subject: Blast ring
text: At level 25, players can reach the 6th floor of the Old Cave in Grenoble to find the Blast ring, which powers up bang spells.

evidence.quote:
Note: I believe you made lots of xp now, expecially with mimickers, you must 
be at level 25, so you can go to Grenoble and go to the 6th floor of the Old 
cave, if you want(check Old cave section).

while, water ring is best.

evidence.quote:
